title: The educated Egyptian: present, discuss, converse

blocks.text: In EGY-17 you have learned to recognize the educated Egyptian: the Egyptian grammar with the vocabulary of fuṣḥā, who use educated people when talking about work, society or current affairs. In this unit learn how to use it: present a topic in three-five minutes, discuss and disagree nicely at a meeting, answer audience questions, hold a free conversation of 15 minutes. You also learn to switch from one register to another: the same Šarīf that in a podcast would saylaʾ w-ēh- In a meeting says "zayy" but ḥaḍratkum šayfīn». It is the last unit of the Egyptian track of B2: In the end you find the Egyptian skills profile to be checked with the tutor. Eight weeks, in parallel with the end of B2-15, B2-16, the Test B2.3 and B2-17.

blocks.text: Materials This unit, an Egyptian tutor, a recorder (also the phone), interviews and authentic Egyptian conferences chosen by the tutor
Targets. At the end of the unit you know:
1. reword in Egyptian read a content said in Egyptian daily;
2. submit an argument in three to five minutes with a clear structure and the appropriate formulas;
3. expressing agreement, reservations and disagreement with politeness, addressing those who listen to ḥaḍritak, ḥaḍratkum;
4. answer public questions and close an intervention;
5. support a 15-minute free conversation, using strategies not to block you.
